manifest.description: Rewrite callers of `*Util.staticMethod(...)` calls to `<provider>.get().method(...)` for one source file. Ships the call-site rewrite half of note-e5439c0a with auto-injection of the @Inject Provider field via the shared di_plumbing helper (delegate_type mode); manual pre-staged-field mode remains as an operator override. Util-class-to-@Singleton conversion + purity classification is still a separate workflow.
when_to_use: redirect callers of a god-Util's static methods toward an injected provider before deleting/converting the Util class itself
anti_patterns: do not use on pure formatter methods that genuinely belong as statics — those should stay as utility methods

delegate_type.description: Type to auto-inject as the new receiver (e.g. `UIUtils`). When set, the planner synthesizes or reuses an `@Inject Provider<DelegateType>` field on the caller's enclosing class via the shared di_plumbing helper. Mutually exclusive with `new_text`.

new_text.description: Manual override: replacement receiver expression (e.g. `uiUtilsProvider.get()`). Use when the provider field is already staged on the enclosing class.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-singletonify-static-util. Charter: Rewrite `<Util>.<staticMethod>(...)` calls to `<provider>.get().<method>(...)`.

Protocol:

1. Ground.
2. Choose mode:
   - Auto-injection (default): pass `delegate_type=<UtilType>` and omit `new_text`; the planner synthesizes or reuses the `@Inject Provider<UtilType>` field on the caller's enclosing class via the shared di_plumbing helper.
   - Manual override: provider field already exists — pass `new_text="<provider>.get()"` and omit `delegate_type`.
3. Plan with item_kinds=["method"]:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="replace_java_static_reference",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}",
                      delegate_type="{{delegate_type}}",   # auto-inject mode; OR
                      new_text="{{new_text}}",             # manual override
                      item_names={{item_names}},
                      item_kinds=["method"])
4. Apply and compile-verify.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{impl_name}} {{delegate_type}} {{new_text}} {{item_names}}
